# Code of conduct

Monfly follows the
[Contributor Covenant 3.0](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/3/0/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be kind and assume good intent, critique the work rather than the
person, and no harassment, discrimination or personal attacks — anywhere Monfly
work happens.

Report a problem to **mrluisfeer@gmail.com**. Reports stay private, and nobody
who reports in good faith faces retaliation.
